Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_messages_received_total
Description: Number of messages received from the Global Brokers on topic (the baseline)

Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_messages_fetched_total
Description: Number of messages retrieved from the Global Replay service by retrieval protocol (http or mqtt)

Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_fetch_delay_time
Description: Milliseconds to the first byte (http) or the first replayed message (mqtt)

Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_test_aborted_flag
Description: Set to 1 when retrieval did not complete within the test period

Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_response_invalid_format_flag
Description: Set to 1 when the response from the Global Replay service was malformed

Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_response_invalid_numberMatched_flag
Description: Set to 1 when the number of messages returned did not equal numberMatched (http only)

Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_http_response_code_value
Description: HTTP status code of the request - 0 when no response was received

Name: wmo_wis2_scgrep_broker_status_flag
Description: Set to 1 when the MQTT connection to upstream broker is established
